latest.notes: Build 5: Qwen3-1.7B fused in, add/delete/rename chats, honest offline model, message order fix, Rtor update check.

install.method: devicectl from the Neo seeder (iOS apps cannot replace themselves)
install.tool: tools/rtor-install-rcode.py install <RCODE.app> (RCODE repo): verifies this appcast's owner signature, the app-tree sha256 and the build, then runs xcrun devicectl device install app

note: Owner signature lives only in the sidecar appcast.json.sig.json (rlab-update-v1, key e5833fdfbbfe). Without it RCODE and the seeder refuse this update.
